balance changes:
- buff-shroom (reworked from 'mushroom'):
    - increases your height by 4x
    - stuns and damages all enemies that you trample

    - increased power juice cost from 2 > 6
- shellshock:

- puffer pal: knockback should now be much more consistent
- hermes' boots: decreased speed from (4/6/8/10) > (3/4/6/8)
- tripmine: decreased power juice cost from 4 > 3

WHAT A DISASTER...

greetings platers!

in the coming days, disaster mode has a possibility of being vaulted until i can create a proper solution for it over the next few weeks. 

with disaster mode, i wanted to make a fresh, fun new mode that introduced a new way to play apg. disaster mode, in my eyes, was a way to reinvent both the way people play average plate gaem, and the way that i develop it. this was not only something i envisioned to be fresh for the playerbase, but also for me, as it would give me new opportunities to build new maps and game mechanics.

unfortunately, with time constraints (delays...)  (school...) (exams...) i was unable to deliver. developing a new mode is almost like developing a new game, which is very hard to fit in one update. for that reason, there were an incredible amount of bugs, very limited content, and frankly, the mode itself was disappointing. for that, i deeply apologize. in a way it felt like i betrayed both the audience and also myself--and that's not really something that's easily forgiven.

as much as i want to immediately fix these issues, it just doesn't make sense to focus all of my effort on this single mode for the time being--this is one of the struggles of being a solo developer™. for that reason, i think disaster mode will be best vaulted for now and reintroduced as disaster mode 2.0 when the issues have been fixed. i want to cater this mode to be perfect for your playstyle.

thanks for understanding, and happy plating! ☀️
